comment: Single source of truth for branch protection (pull_request) and the publish workflows' release gate (release). Validated against .github/workflows by scripts/release_gate.py validate (CI job 'Required-check names exist'). Go modules are published by the tag itself; tag creation must be restricted by a ruleset (OWNER-ACTIONS.md). verify-tag.yml runs the gate on every v* tag as a detector.
pull_request: Vendored kernel vectors match the pinned kernel
release: Vendored kernel vectors match the pinned kernel
